text: Michael Anderson Pereira da Silva, born on February 16, 1983, is a Brazilian former professional footballer who played as a left midfielder. He began his professional career at Santo André before joining Cruzeiro, where he spent one season before transferring to São Paulo, playing for Palmeiras. After two seasons with Palmeiras, he signed a three-year contract with the Ukrainian club Dynamo Kyiv in July 2007. Michael made his debut for Dynamo on 22 July against Arsenal Kyiv, scoring a double in the match. In UPL Round 2, he made his UEFA Champions League debut in a group stage game against the Italian team Roma. Throughout the autumn and winter of 2007, Michael was injured and received treatment in Brazil, but he recovered and returned to play. On 13 May 2009, he moved on loan from Dynamo Kyiv to Botafogo, with the loan lasting until 31 December 2009. He then transferred from Kyiv to Portuguesa on 23 May 2011. This information is confirmed by combined sources from the Flamengo official website and Flaestatística.
